name: Kaizuka Masanobu
source:
A second-year student. Often skips school, only attends band practice.
Plays bass, though not particularly skilled.
Became a fanatic fan after seeing Hiromitsu’s performance.
With Sugita and Tsujii, shares a love-hate relationship—yet they are among the few friends trusted deeply.
